geeklist.title: GAMESGALORE’S 2026 BGG AUCTION #1 – NEW YEAR’S AUCTION WITH LOTS OF GREAT GAMES!! – ENDS TUESDAY, JANUARY 6TH!!
geeklist.description:
I hope everyone had a fantastic holiday season!! Here’s my first auction of 2026…15 fantastic games, including some recent releases!! All of the games are complete and in Excellent to Mint condition (with one minor exception). If you didn’t get that present you wanted, treat yourself to one of these!! Check them out and grab the ones you want!! More details of this sale follow:
[u][b]The Auction - Specifics[/b][/u]
[b]1. This is a BGG Flea Market auction…all sales will be run through BGG [u]in bulk[/u] so BGG receives its commission! 2. Auction Ends – Tuesday, January 6th[/b] 3. All buyers welcome…will ship worldwide 4. All bids must be in whole US dollar increments 5. Please add a zip code to all bids as this expedites the billing process at the end of the auction 6. All games will have a minimum bid AND a Buy It Now (BIN) price…no “reserves” 7. The auction will end on January 6th after there is no activity for a period of one hour past 8pm EST that evening 8. If there is activity from 8pm to 9pm EST that evening, the auction for that item will be extended by one hour 9. This will continue until an hour goes by with no activity on the item, at which point the auction will end
[b]Payments & Shipping[/b]
1. You will receive a billing notice from me through Geekmail regarding your auction winnings 2. [u]BGG gets its commission from a single “bulk bill” at the end of the auction[/u]. The winning bidders will receive a billing notice through GeekMail from me…the sales will [u][b]NOT[/b][/u] individually run through the BGG Marketplace. This is a standard and accepted practice from BGG and they will get their full commission at the end of the auction! 3. Payments will be through PayPal at the end of the auction 4. Payment is expected [u][b]within three days of the close of the auction; this is very important…please make payment promptly![/b][/u] 5. Shipping will be through USPS Priority Mail, USPS International Mail or UPS 6. Buyer is responsible for shipping costs 7. Shipping will be from zip code 43021 8. I will combine games to get the best shipping prices 9. You are welcome to pick up your games locally (in the Columbus, OH area) if you want to save the shipping and handling charges. We can make arrangements post-auction.
That’s it! Good luck to everyone and thank you for your interest. Please feel free to contact me through BGG if you have any questions!
Lyle Rhodebeck Gamesgalore

Complete and Excellent!! Only item of note with this game. It comes with 9 bonus scoring tiles. About 2/3 of the way through my first game, I spilled some water on my game table, and four of these tokens were laying off to the side and got a bit wet. I dried them out, and a few pieces of paper peeled off of them. Those sections are colored in. It is minor...one side was mostly unaffected, and the other side of the four had some minor issues. I have included links to photos so you can see this. The top 5 have no issue at all. The bottom four were the ones that got wet. Really no affect on gameplay, as before the game starts you randomly select 7 of these 9 for the game. We usually drew them out of one of the boxes that come with the game, since these tiles are two-sided. Otherwise, the game is in superb condition! Priced accordingly!
MIN BID - $35.00
BIN - $60.00
